messages:
Aisha: FYI perf alert from the runtime team: host p95 up ~5% on tiny requests after the kernel selector rollout. Graph: https://dash.redwood/hosts/p95?t=last_30m :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Ben: saw it. Any signs in batching histograms or kvcache hits?
Aisha: Quick dig: running-batch-size median dropped from 4 -> 2 on canary hosts. KV cache remote-fallbacks rose ~2.5% coincidentally.
Carmen: Interesting. Kernel-selector made a few model-shape heuristics change earlier; maybe picking the "fused" kernel that helps long sequences but is heavier for short seqs. That would reduce throughput per-core -> smaller batches.
Ben: Can you share a sample span? I want breakdown for parse/tokenize/net/kernel.
Aisha: Paste below (simplified):
```
11:02:01.001 parse_request  0.9ms
11:02:01.002 tokenize       3.1ms
11:02:01.006 kvcache_lookup 0.7ms (miss -> fetch 5.0ms)
11:02:01.012 kernel_exec   20.8ms
11:02:01.033 grpc_writev    4.0ms (3 frames)
```
Ben: Tokenize is non-trivial now fractionally. Kernel_exec jump + kvcache miss remote fetch kills the p95.
Carmen: Two risk amplifiers: heavy kernel -> lower concurrency -> more small batches -> kvcache hot-shard contention -> remote fetches -> extra network smallwrites. Feedback loop.
Aisha: Mitigation plan: 1) soft-rollback selector to previous policy on canary (infra-bot), 2) add a selector gating rule: prefer light kernel when observed running-batch-size < 3, 3) emit per-host metrics: kernel_variant, running_batch_p90, kvcache_remote_rate, smallwrite_count.
deploy-bot: Received request: initiating soft-rollback for selector config on canary.
infra-bot: Soft-rollback in progress. ETA ~90s.
Ben: For long-term: include a host-side cost estimate in kernel scoring: parse+tokenize+network estimate per request shape. Right now selector only uses kernel token throughput.
Carmen: Agreed. Also evaluate pretokenization sidecar for ultra-short requests: remove tokenize CPU from host but add sidecar RPCs. Need perf model end-to-end.
Aisha: I'll attach the replay job logs (2k small requests against canary model) and add a micro-benchmark to the rollout pipeline to catch similar regressions.
infra-bot: Soft-rollback complete. Canary hosts reporting normalized p95.
Aisha: Closing immediate alert. Will open RFC thread with telemetry + gating + selector scoring changes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
